description: The single source of truth for every label in annavetech/kumi. .github/scripts/sync_labels.py makes the repo's labels match this file exactly: creates missing ones, updates color/description on mismatched ones, deletes ones not listed here. Edit this file, not the repo's label list directly.

labels.name: kind/bug
labels.description: A behavior that is wrong relative to what the docs or code promise.

labels.name: kind/enhancement
labels.description: A new capability or an improvement to an existing one.

labels.name: kind/cleanup
labels.description: Refactor, rename, or remove without changing behavior.

labels.name: kind/documentation
labels.description: Docs-only change: README, docs/, examples, or a skill's prose.

labels.name: kind/question
labels.description: A question, not yet a confirmed bug or a proposed change.

labels.name: priority/p0
labels.description: Drop everything: broken for every user, or a security issue.

labels.name: priority/p1
labels.description: Should land in the next release.

labels.name: priority/p2
labels.description: Worth doing, no fixed timeline.

labels.name: priority/p3
labels.description: Nice to have.

labels.name: status/needs-triage
labels.description: Not yet looked at by a maintainer.

labels.name: status/needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on the reporter for more detail.

labels.name: status/design
labels.description: Needs a kai spec before implementation starts.

labels.name: status/in-progress
labels.description: Actively being worked on.

labels.name: status/needs-review
labels.description: Implementation done, waiting on review.

labels.name: status/blocked
labels.description: Cannot proceed until something else resolves.

labels.name: size/XS
labels.description: Fewer than 10 lines changed.

labels.name: size/S
labels.description: 10-29 lines changed.

labels.name: size/M
labels.description: 30-99 lines changed.

labels.name: size/L
labels.description: 100-499 lines changed.

labels.name: size/XL
labels.description: 500-999 lines changed.

labels.name: size/XXL
labels.description: 1000 or more lines changed.

labels.name: area/skills
labels.description: skills/

labels.name: area/agents
labels.description: agents/ (generated — see scripts/build_agents.py)

labels.name: area/hooks
labels.description: hooks/ (memory, observability, shared state)

labels.name: area/scripts
labels.description: scripts/ (the plugin's own tooling, e.g. build_agents.py)

labels.name: area/tests
labels.description: tests/ and evals/

labels.name: area/docs
labels.description: docs/, examples/, and root-level *.md

labels.name: area/config
labels.description: config/, template/, .claude-plugin/

labels.name: area/ci
labels.description: .github/ — workflows and repo automation

labels.name: do-not-merge/hold
labels.description: Blocks merge until removed. Set by /hold, cleared by /unhold.

labels.name: do-not-merge/work-in-progress
labels.description: Not ready for review or merge yet.

labels.name: lgtm
labels.description: Looks good to me. Set by /lgtm from someone with write access.

labels.name: approved
labels.description: Approved to merge. Set by /approve (write access). With lgtm and no do-not-merge/*, gate passes.

labels.name: ok-to-test
labels.description: CI is authorized to run for this PR. Set by /ok-to-test from a maintainer.

labels.name: needs-ok-to-test
labels.description: Opened by an account without write access; a maintainer must comment /ok-to-test.

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: A reasonable starting point for a new contributor.

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Extra attention or a contributor is wanted.

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Already reported or requested elsewhere.

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: Doesn't apply, or not enough information to act on.

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: Will not be worked on.

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: A Dependabot-opened update.

labels.name: stale
labels.description: No activity for 60 days; will close in 7 more unless it changes.
